results.name: Person death-before-birth validation
Residence rows: add, change location/year, remove and save
All event/document type choices persist and render
Branch-wide migration and required-empty selectors
Modal cancel, close icon, and backdrop discard drafts
Empty multiselect search/no-match, select and keyboard-remove chip
Dedicated parent, child and spouse add/remove updates both people
Deleting people removes relationships, document/event links and personal routes
Deleting events and documents cleans reciprocal links
Delete populated branch: remove members, preserve people and routes
Delete populated branch: move members, preserve people and routes
JSON export/import round-trip retains all collections
Invalid JSON rejected without replacing archive
Reset cancellation preserves data; confirmation restores sample
Empty archive: all screens, management tabs, and first-person setup
HTML-like user text is displayed as text, not executed
Person form relationship changes must update the other person
Adding a residence must keep the migration route collection synchronized
Event document selector must update the document event links
Document event selector must update event document links
Deleting a location must clean event location references
Reject ancestor cycles
Changing relationship person must clear the target and reject self-links
Adding siblings without parents must not silently do nothing
Reject latitude and longitude outside geographic bounds
Reject a migration ending before it starts or going to its origin
Reject fractional years
Residence year must not precede birth
A person outside fixed year bounds must be explorable in time
Structurally invalid JSON must be rejected without changing the archive
Malformed person records must not crash the application
Valid import replacing existing data must require confirmation
Storage failures must produce a visible persistence warning
Two tabs must synchronize rather than overwrite each other
Deleting the selected branch must reset its global filter
People with unknown residences must not inflate place totals
Keyboard activation of global search results must open profile
Modal Escape closes and modal has accessible dialog semantics
Tab focus stays inside open modal
Interactive controls must have accessible names
Empty multiselect can be reached and opened with the keyboard
Responsive 390px: all sidebar destinations remain named and layout fits
Responsive 768px: all sidebar destinations remain named and layout fits
Mobile year slider must remain within its visible container
Mobile family search must have enough room to enter and read a name
Escape must close an edit modal
Empty People search must provide a no-results message
Spouse generation alignment must also keep children below parents
Saving a person biography must not remove existing branch assignments
Clicking branch selector and cancelling must preserve draft tags
Person linked-event and linked-document fields update the related people arrays
Last populated branch cannot move members to a nonexistent branch
Relationship Add is disabled without a target person
Export failure shows an error without changing archive data
Profile parent and child navigation and close icon
